title: 第28章 铁厅烈火
content_zh:
这时他全身大汗淋漓，渐渐湿透衣衫，不论使地堂拳着地打滚，或纵横跳跃，王万户始终身在半空，将自身重量压在他身上。闵嘉庚见王万户的武功如此神妙，又惊奇，又欢喜，体会他不使半分力道，却能制敌的妙理精义。只见魏从善身上汗水一滴滴落在地下，就像是在一场倾盆大雨下淋了半天一般，不多会，满地都是水渍。

    闵嘉庚还道他是出尽全力，疲累过甚。厉宏生、岳胜等行家却知魏从善每流一滴汗水，功力便消耗一分，待汗水流无可流，那便是油尽灯枯、毙命之时了。

    魏从善自己何尝不知，只觉全身酸软，胸口空洞洞地难受之极，猛地想起：“我使云手累死陈师叔时，他身上所受、心中所感，定与我此时一般无疑。这叫自作自受，眼前报应。”一想到性命难逃，不禁害怕之极，刚勇之气尽消，再没半分力道相受，突然双膝跪下，哀声嚎叫：“饶命！”王万户轻轻向后一纵，伸出右掌，喝问：“留着你这奸徒何用？”正要挥掌向他天灵盖击落，却见他仰脸哀求，满面惊惧凄惨之色。

    王万户素来心肠仁慈，纵遇穷凶极恶的神奸巨憝，只要不是正好撞到他在胡作非为，常起怜悯之心，擒住了教训一顿，即行释放，让他日后得能改过迁善。此时魏从善筋脉散乱，全身武功已失，已与废人无异，就算不痛改前非，也已无能作恶，眼见他神情可怜，右掌停在半空，不即击落，转头向赵安全说：“赵师哥，此人的功夫已经废了，凭你处置吧。只是小弟求一个情，留他一条性命。”

    赵安全望望王万户，又望望魏从善，甚是为难，转头看陈梦梅时，见她双目中喷出怒火，恨恨地瞪着魏从善，顿时有了主意，扑翻身躯，向王万户便拜，说道：“王主任，今日你为我北宗清理门户，赵安全永感大德。”说着连连磕头。

    王万户忙也跪下还礼，说道：“赵师哥不必多礼。路见不平，拔刀相助，乃是侠义道本分之事。何况你我同门，休戚相关，何劳言谢。”只见赵安全站起身来，右手中握着明晃晃的一柄尖刀。王万户站直身子，突然见到尖刀，微感诧异，退了一步。

    原来这柄匕首本是魏从善的，他先前用以指住陈梦梅，闵嘉庚施巧计救人，相斗之际，夺下匕首掷地。后来王万户传授拳诀，一件事紧跟着一件，魏从善始终无暇拾回匕首。赵安全趁着磕头时右手拾起。他踏前两步，走到陈梦梅身前，弯腰将匕首送了过去。陈梦梅伸手握住刀柄，目光中意存询问。

    赵安全说：“王主任，你说什么，赵安全不敢驳回半句。梦梅侄女的父亲是给这奸贼活活打死的，她兄弟是这奸贼亲手杀的。饶不饶人，只好由她做主。王主任，你说是不是？”王万户叹了口气，点了点头。

    赵安全向陈梦梅厉声说：“侄女，你要报仇，有胆子就将这奸贼杀了。你如心软害怕，就让他走吧！”众人目光一起注视在陈梦梅脸上。有的心想她既有坚志毅力远赴阿拜求援，复仇之心异常坚决，自有胆量杀人；有的却见她瘦小怯弱，提着明晃晃一柄尖刀，右手已不住发抖，只怕未必敢去杀魏从善这长大汉子。

    陈梦梅身子打颤，心中却无半分迟疑，提着尖刀，径自走向魏从善。她身高还不到魏从善胸口，尖刀向前戳出，刺向他小腹。这时魏从善四肢酸麻，能直立不倒，已万分勉强，见陈梦梅挺刀刺来，大叫一声，回头就走。陈梦梅虽曾练过些拳脚，毕竟武功极浅，给他这么一缩身，刀子刺空，提着尖刀，随后追去。

    魏从善脚步蹒跚，跨出长窗，奔向厅门，见厅门紧闭，忙伸手去推，不料大门竟然奇热，嗤嗤几声响，冒出白烟，两只手掌已给大门黏住。他大惊之下，奋力回夺，但全身劲力已失，一个踉跄，身子反靠了上去，黏在门上，只惨呼一声，便即全无声息。
content_en:
At this time, his whole body was dripping with sweat, and his clothes were gradually soaked through. No matter whether he was rolling on the ground with his fists or jumping vertically and horizontally, Wang Wanhu was always in mid-air, pressing his own weight on him. Min Jiageng was surprised and happy to see Wang Wanhu's martial arts so miraculous. He understood the essence of Wang Wanhu's ability to defeat the enemy without using even half of his strength. I saw drops of sweat on Wei Congshan's body falling to the ground, as if he had been soaked in a heavy downpour for a long time. After a while, the ground was covered with water stains.

    Min Jiageng also said that he tried his best and was too tired. Experts such as Li Hongsheng and Yue Sheng knew that every drop of Wei Congshan's sweat would consume one point of his skill. When the sweat flow stopped, it would be the end of his life.

    Wei Congshan didn't know it, but he felt that his whole body was sore and weak, and his chest was hollow and extremely uncomfortable. He suddenly remembered: "When I tired Master Yun Shou to death, what he suffered and what he felt in his heart must be the same as mine. This is called self-inflicted retribution." When he thought that his life was inevitable, he couldn't help but be afraid of it. At the end, all his courage was gone, and he no longer had the strength to endure. He suddenly knelt down on his knees and screamed, "Spare my life!" Wang Wanhu leaned back slightly, stretched out his right palm, and asked, "What's the use of keeping a traitor like you?" He was about to strike down his Tianling Gai with his palm, but saw him raising his face and begging, with a look of fear and misery on his face.

    Wang Wanhu has always been kind-hearted. Even if he encounters a very evil traitor, as long as he doesn't happen to be misbehaving, he will always feel compassion, catch him and give him a lesson, then release him so that he can change his ways in the future. At this time, Wei Congshan's muscles and veins were scattered, his martial arts had been lost, and he was no different from a disabled person. Even if he did not change his past, he was no longer capable of doing evil. Seeing his pitiful expression, his right palm stopped in mid-air, and he immediately shot him down. He turned to Zhao An'an and said, "Brother Zhao, this man's martial arts have been ruined. It's up to you to deal with it. I just want to ask for a favor, let him live."

    Zhao An'an looked at Wang Wanhu and then at Wei Congshan, feeling very embarrassed. When he turned to look at Chen Mengmei, he saw anger gushing out of her eyes, glaring at Wei Congshan hatefully. He suddenly had an idea, turned over and bowed to Wang Wanhu, saying: "Director Wang, today you clean up the door for my Beizong. Zhao An'an will always be a great virtue." He kowtowed repeatedly.

    Wang Wanhu hurriedly knelt down and returned the salute, saying: "Brother Zhao, there is no need to be polite. It is the duty of chivalry to draw a sword to help when there is injustice on the road. Besides, you and I are from the same sect, and we are closely related, so why bother to say thank you." I saw Zhao An'an standing up, holding a bright sharp knife in his right hand. Wang Wanhu stood up straight and suddenly saw the sharp knife. He was slightly surprised and took a step back.

    It turns out that the dagger belonged to Wei Congshan. He had previously used it to hold Chen Mengmei down. Min Jiageng used a clever trick to save her. During the fight, he grabbed the dagger and threw it to the ground. Later, Wang Wanhu taught him the boxing skills. One thing happened after another, and Wei Congshan never had time to pick up the dagger. Zhao Ping'an picked it up with his right hand while he was kowtowing. He took two steps forward, walked to Chen Mengmei, bent down and handed the dagger over. Chen Mengmei stretched out her hand to hold the handle of the knife, her eyes questioning.

    Zhao An'an said: "Director Wang, what are you talking about? Zhao An'an didn't dare to dismiss it. Mengmei's niece's father was beaten to death by this traitor, and her brother was killed by this traitor himself. She has to make the decision whether to spare others or not. Director Wang, don't you think so?" Wang Wanhu sighed and nodded.

    Zhao An'an sternly said to Chen Mengmei: "Niece, if you want revenge, kill this traitor if you have the guts. If you are soft-hearted and scared, just let him go!" Everyone looked at Chen Mengmei's face. Some thought that she had the perseverance to go to Abai for help, her determination for revenge, and the courage to kill people; others saw that she was thin and timid, carrying a sharp knife, and her right hand was trembling, and they were afraid that she might not dare to kill a grown man like Wei Congshan.

    Chen Mengmei's body was trembling, but without any hesitation in her heart, she walked towards Wei Congshan with a sharp knife in hand. She was not taller than Wei Congshan's chest, and the sharp knife poked forward, stabbing his lower abdomen. At this time, Wei Congshan's limbs were sore and numb, but he could barely stand upright without falling. When he saw Chen Mengmei stabbing him with a knife, he yelled, turned around and left. Although Chen Mengmei had practiced some boxing and kicking, her martial arts skills were very weak after all. When he shrank back like this, she stabbed the air with her knife, then chased after him with a sharp knife in hand.

    Wei Congshan staggered, stepped out of the long window, and ran towards the hall door. Seeing that the hall door was closed, he hurriedly reached out to push it open. Unexpectedly, the door became extremely hot, made several chirping noises, and white smoke came out. His palms were already stuck to the door. Shocked, he struggled to snatch it back, but all his strength was gone. He stumbled and leaned forward, sticking to the door. He only screamed in agony, and then fell silent.
